text.en: Handlers frequently praise Davina and James for their empathetic approach, deep canine knowledge, and welcoming manner during classes. Clients note that instructors explain exercises without condescension and make owners feel at ease. The trainers focus on positive reinforcement methods.

Dog owners report rapid improvements in loose lead walking, impulse control, and calm behaviour around distractions. Several clients mention that both puppies and working breeds developed reliable habits through foundation classes. One handler noted slight progress before class schedules shifted.

Reviewers emphasize the no-fear philosophy used across all puppy and adult dog sessions. Handlers observe that their dogs genuinely look forward to meeting Davina and work eagerly during drills. The training accommodates both energetic working spaniels and sensitive young puppies.

q.en: Does Davina offer one-to-one dog training sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently book private one-to-one sessions focusing on specific topics such as lead walking and reactivity.

q.en: What training methodology is used during classes?

a.en: Reviewers report that training relies on positive reinforcement and reward-based methods without force or intimidation.
